factors.text: This is a ‘10+ units’ application; across Ireland these are refused 20% of the time.
The most similar past applications to this scheme were refused 40% of the time.
Applications in Dun Laoghaire Rathdown County Council have recently been refused 12% of the time.
Recent applications within 1km of the site were refused 13% of the time.
The scheme is at 30 homes per hectare – the low (below 35 homes/ha) band.
The scheme provides 333 m² of site per home.

apartment_block_dlr.summary: Together these factors give an estimated 35% chance of refusal and 65% chance of grant.
apartment_block_dlr.note: Model-attributed drivers; the percentages are historical rates, not guarantees.
